status: design complete; no hardware events acquired
purpose: Create the smallest prospective dataset that can test RC41's g=1, a=1 separator condition with real, identity-preserving omissions and independently adjudicated relay-event truth.

truthStates.definition: No mechanical contact transition within the 20 ms adjudication window.
Exactly one open-to-closed or closed-to-open mechanical contact transition within the window.
Two or more mechanical contact transitions, including bounce, within the window.

causalChain: A precommitted coil-drive schedule and event roster define every expected trial and report slot.
Four measurement principles produce identity-indexed raw records through separately powered and stored acquisition chains.
Development trials estimate healthy supports for E0, E1, and E2 without using holdout video labels to alter thresholds.
A common-input graph collapses any channels that share a standard, supply, clock, processor, storage path, or environmental correction.
Every truth pair must retain at least four evidenced separator domains for g=1 and a=1.
A physically separate high-speed video chain adjudicates holdout truth; a singleton compatible set is required for an exact certificate.

measurementDomains.calibration: sealed resistor-substitution ladder measured before and after each block
measurementDomains.separationTarget: E0 has no state crossing; E1 has one; E2 has at least two after deglitching fixed on development data
measurementDomains.isolation: dedicated battery, ADC, oscillator, and removable storage

measurementDomains.calibration: gauge-block displacement series with a separate readout chain
measurementDomains.separationTarget: transition count from crossings of two fixed position bands
measurementDomains.isolation: dedicated supply, digitizer, oscillator, and storage

measurementDomains.calibration: mechanical impulse fixture plus local pulse-timing check; no electrical-contact labels
measurementDomains.separationTarget: zero, one, or repeated impact clusters under a frozen matched-filter threshold
measurementDomains.isolation: dedicated charge amplifier, battery, digitizer, oscillator, and storage

measurementDomains.principle: interrupted-beam optical flag on the armature
measurementDomains.calibration: opaque calibration flag and independent translation-stage positions
measurementDomains.separationTarget: zero, one, or repeated beam crossings without reading electrical continuity
measurementDomains.isolation: dedicated light source, detector, battery, comparator, oscillator, and storage

independentReference.principle: high-speed video of an armature fiducial and contact witness mark
independentReference.requiredResolution: At least five frames across the shortest development bounce interval; otherwise increase frame rate before holdout.
independentReference.isolation: separate power, clock, camera, operator, and storage; video is unavailable to support-calibration code until predictions are sealed
independentReference.adjudication: Two blinded reviewers label E0, E1, or E2 from frame sequences. Disagreement or insufficient temporal resolution is inconclusive, not majority truth.
independentReference.forbiddenReuse: Video-derived thresholds, timing corrections, or labels may not tune any of the four certificate domains after holdout begins.

development.use: support estimation, threshold freezing, and minimum-separator table

trialPlan.ordering: Block-randomized by truth-generating condition with event IDs and all five expected report slots committed before acquisition.
trialPlan.minimumBlockRule: Each truth state appears in every environmental block in development and holdout.

frozenInjections: one-domain offset or gain substitution inside its development envelope
one-domain replay of a previous event with preserved domain identity
one expected report replaced by a signed null containing slot, domain, event, epoch, and reason
one common supply or clock perturbation; every affected channel must be collapsed before adjudication
faultAndOmissionChallenge.forbiddenInjection: Never create a hazardous coil overvoltage, defeat protective enclosures, or inject faults into mains-powered equipment.

slotLedger.invariant: expected slots = observed slots + authenticated null slots; deleted or unknown slots = 0
slotLedger.identityRule: Values may never be sorted or pooled without retaining domainId and eventId.

uncertaintyBudget.requiredEstimate: couplant repeatability, impulse-amplitude distribution, false-cluster rate

uncertaintyBudget.source: optical flag geometry and ambient light
uncertaintyBudget.requiredEstimate: beam-width uncertainty, flag alignment, detector saturation
per-chain drift and cross-clock alignment error; never assume a shared trigger proves independent timing
frame interval, exposure blur, reviewer disagreement, unresolved transitions
repeat the full holdout on a second relay before any device-class claim

successCriteria: All 270 planned trials satisfy the slot-ledger invariant or are excluded only by a predeclared whole-event rule.
Every E0/E1, E0/E2, and E1/E2 pair has at least four independently evidenced separator domains after common-input collapse.
The frozen compatible-set adjudicator returns the video label as a singleton for every resolved holdout trial under each g=1, a=1 challenge.
JavaScript and an independent implementation agree on every domain assignment, separator count, compatible set, and refusal.
A second relay reproduces the verdict before claims extend beyond the tested device.
rejectionAndStopRules: One false exact holdout certificate rejects the current certificate design.
Any truth pair with fewer than four evidenced separators forces set-valued output and stops exact testing.
Any undeclared shared standard, power supply, clock, processor, or storage path collapses the affected channels and triggers recomputation.
Any missing record without its precommitted slot identity invalidates the event for omission-resilience testing.
Video resolution or reviewer disagreement that cannot distinguish E1 from E2 yields inconclusive reference truth.
Thermal rise, component damage, exposed conductors, or enclosure violation stops acquisition immediately.
deliverables: raw byte hashes and calibration lineage for five acquisition chains
development support table and frozen pairwise separator matrix
blinded video adjudication and independent software audit
